title: FNAF 6 Jumpscare
blurb: Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator spent about four minutes pretending to be a cheerful tycoon game before revealing what it actually was. Here is the payoff: the salvage-room jumpscare waiting for anyone who kept clicking salvage instead of toss for the extra cash. Greed is the whole mechanic and this sound is the invoice. It is noticeably cleaner and better mixed than the lo-fi screeches of the 2014 originals, which somehow makes it worse, because you can hear in full detail what is happening to you.
origin: The salvage jumpscare from Freddy Fazbear's Pizzeria Simulator (FNAF 6, 2017).
